sections.title: Monthly default salary overview
sections.content:
## Purpose

Monthly default salary is used to declare a salary or allowance by effective date for the driver or the vehicle it applies to.

## Access

**Menu:** Driver salary > Monthly default salary

![](/uploads/ed6a8858b860bd991781d950.png)

The list screen shows the monthly default salary records already declared.

![](/uploads/d62ea276c05542f74e7902b4.png)

sections.title: Creating a monthly default salary
sections.content:
### Step 1

Click **New**.

![](/uploads/891f7876ab5f6ceef782f6f6.png)

### Step 2

Enter the general information and the scope it applies to.

![](/uploads/65f806e99b96a6c535ab664b.png)

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Effective date | Date it starts applying. |
| Item | Type of salary or allowance. |
| Amount | Amount that applies. |
| Description | Additional notes, if any. |
| Driver | Driver it applies to. |
| Vehicle | Vehicle it applies to. |

![](/uploads/48fdd3b655dd156619341cba.png)

### Step 3

Click **Save manually** to finish.

![](/uploads/335aa21fe2979d7d546b7752.png)
